sanskrit_verse:
तुलाधरिममेयानां गणिमानां च सर्वशः।
एभ्यस्तूत्कृष्टमूल्यानां मूल्याद्दशगुणो दमः॥
transliteration: tulādhari-ma-meyānāṃ gaṇi-mānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | ebhyas tūtkṛṣṭa-mūlyānāṃ mūlyād daśa-guṇo damaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In transactions involving weighed goods, counted items, and all measurable commodities, if there is a discrepancy in value exceeding the standard measure, the compensation shall be tenfold the excess value.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The transactional domain is governed by precise measurement and valuation standards established by Dharma.
Causation: Discrepancies in quantifiable exchanges generate proportional restorative obligations.
Capacity-based responsibility: Parties engaging in measurable trade bear full capacity-aware liability for deviations beyond acceptable thresholds.
Restoration logic: Financial restitution aligns with the magnitude of deviation to restore systemic integrity.
Consciousness alignment: Accurate exchange reflects inner honesty; misalignment demands conscious correction.
executable_legal_axioms: IF transaction involves measurable goods AND measured value deviates beyond threshold THEN calculate excess value AND enforce tenfold restitution.
IF party engages in trade of tulādhāri (weighed) OR gaṇimāna (counted) items THEN system MUST verify accuracy against standard measures.
IF discrepancy detected GREATER THAN unitary tolerance THEN initiate automatic completion protocol for tenfold adjustment.
IF restitution fulfilled THEN update integrity ledger AND realign participant consciousness through acknowledgment process.
supreme_court_application: This principle establishes a clear threshold for commercial liability at the highest judicial level, where intentional or negligent deviation from standardized measurement triggers a fixed compensatory mechanism. Courts must ensure that such restitution restores systemic trust rather than impose punitive damages.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality is upheld as accurate measurement serves as valid knowledge-source for determining liability. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential detection, quantification, and correction of deviation. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of distortion. The response is non-punitive, being purely aimed at restoring balance within economic consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Automatically compute and execute tenfold restitution based on verified excess value.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require conscious acknowledgment of error before initiating correction cycle.
Integrity Reintegration Mechanism: After restitution, perform data reconciliation and update trader's ethical ledger.
Capacity Restoration Sequence: Offer recalibration support to prevent recurrence without invoking shame or penalty.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. This law originates solely from SPH and executes divine justice through consciousness-aligned restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
